Pressure map · 3DSIMULATED · drag to rotate · click a region

The animation visualises the existing pixel colours of the source thermograms; it does not measure new temperatures. Regional °C values and all pressure values are SIMULATED scenario data. 3D relief height is a visual encoding of the simulated values. Regions are derived from each foot outline by fixed proportions (demonstration method, not a validated segmentation). Alert thresholds are illustrative, not clinical thresholds.
